slides.h1: I shipped my first iOS app to the App Store.
slides.lead: Here's the whole process — from idea to “Ready for Distribution.”

slides.h2:
I live in a tower with hundreds of neighbors.
I knew none of them.
slides.lead: The only “community” was a WhatsApp group nobody read, an email nobody opened, and a notice board nobody looked at.

slides.h2: Build the smallest thing that solves it.
points: One core loop: find your building, post, meet your neighbors
Everything else goes on a “later” list
Account deletion — it has to work inside the app

slides.lead: After 7 rejections, those three words hit different.

slides.h2:
Launch day isn't the finish line.
It's the start line.
slides.lead: Now comes the hard part: getting real people to download it.
A community app for the people in your building. Live on the App Store now.
slides.cta: Follow to watch me grow it from 0 →
